title: Donation-and-Resale Diversion Log
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=repair:event (action="donated" OR action="resold")
| stats count as items_diverted, sum(estimated_kg) as diverted_kg by action category
| sort - diverted_kg
description: Tracks items diverted to donation or resale instead of landfill when they leave your home.
value: Diversion is a meaningful sustainability metric because it captures useful life extension, not just recycling.
implementation: Capture donated and resold items as `repair:event` records and summarize diverted item counts and weight.
visualization: Table of donated and resold items by category.

references.title: EPA — reducing wasted food at home

grandmaExplanation: It maps how many things you kept in circulation by donating or reselling them instead of binning them.
